title: sucoder: unix-account isolation for LLM coding agents
description:
sucoder treats an LLM coding agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini) as a collaborator with its own unix account, relying on fifty years of battle-tested unix user and group permissions rather than bespoke container runtimes or sandboxing daemons. The human's canonical repository is group-readable but not group-writable; the agent works in a sandboxed mirror clone where it has full write access. The isolation boundary is enforced by chown, chmod, and git.

The tool detects a git repository, mirrors it, and launches the chosen agent against the mirror, optionally on a dedicated task branch.
